ALF.Jurisdiction Role: All personnel
ALF.Training Topic / Competency Item: Infection Control Training: Facility must develop Infection Control Plan including designation of Infection Control Lead, description of infection control practices, and Infection Control Training Plan
ALF.Frequency: Upon hire; annually; updated per public health orders
ALF.Notes / Research Flags: IC Plan must be reviewed at least annually, upon outbreak determination by local public health, or upon request by licensing agency.

ALF.Jurisdiction Role: All personnel, volunteers, and persons having contact with residents
ALF.Training Topic / Competency Item: Criminal Background Clearance (Live Scan): DOJ and FBI criminal background check via Live Scan fingerprinting prior to employment/presence in facility
ALF.Notes / Research Flags: Employment eligibility mandate, not training. Exemption process available for certain prior convictions. Clearance can transfer between CCL facilities.

ALF.Jurisdiction Role: All personnel, including the licensee and administrator
ALF.Training Topic / Competency Item: Employee Health Screening: good physical health verified by health screening, including a chest x-ray or an intradermal test, performed by a physician not more than six (6) months prior to or seven (7) days after employment or licensure
ALF.Frequency: One-time (within 6 months before or 7 days after hire)
ALF.Notes / Research Flags: Employment health eligibility mandate. Report must indicate whether person is physically qualified and whether they have any hazardous condition.

ALF.Jurisdiction Role: Assisted living facility employee
ALF.Training Topic / Competency Item: Preservice Orientation: at least 2 hours in duration and cover topics that help the employee provide responsible care and respond to the needs of facility residents
ALF.Notes / Research Flags: Administrator and employee must sign statement of completion; kept in personnel file. 1-hr ADRD training under §430.5025 may count toward these 2 hours.

ALF.Jurisdiction Role: Assisted living facility employee who provides personal care or has regular contact with residents
ALF.Training Topic / Competency Item: ADRD Universal Training: 1-hour training on Alzheimer's disease and related dementias provided by DOEA
ALF.Notes / Research Flags: May count toward 2-hr preservice orientation. All new employees must also receive basic written information on interacting with persons with ADRD. ALF employees in limited mental health facilities exempt. Enacted by CS/CS/HB 299 (2023).

ALF.Training Topic / Competency Item: ALF Core Training + Competency Test: minimum 26 hours of training plus competency test (75% minimum passing score)

ALF.Notes / Research Flags: Structure row. Managers must also complete within 3 months. Licensed NHAs (Ch. 468 Part II) exempt. Topics enumerated in §429.52(3)(a)–(g) below. Failure within 90 days = administrative fine per §429.19.

ALF.Approval Required: Yes – must be provided by RN or RPh
ALF.Notes / Research Flags: Unlicensed staff only. Must be completed before assuming medication duties. Staff trained prior to May 10, 2018 under old 4-hr standard must complete additional 2 hours on new topics.

ALF.Approval Required: Yes – must be provided by RN or RPh
ALF.Notes / Research Flags: May be face-to-face or webinar. Additive to general in-service requirements.

ALF.Notes / Research Flags: Must be provided by certified food manager, licensed dietitian, registered dietary technician, or health department sanitarian.
